post.originalText:
Grok 4.7 was the dark horse here.

Same prompt, one shot: pixel-art druid ➜ bear loop, vanilla JS + Canvas.

Gemini 4 Argon: quick, my fav druid, IMO my fav
Opus 5.5: best bear, but 10+ min
Grok 4.7: quickest, under 2 min, surprisingly good

Which do you like most? https://t.co/SSBWrzGIuK
